title: Founding team planning session
description: Confirm the charter team, leadership interests, operating roles, table plan, and first-semester priorities.

title: Student organization fair table
description: Meet new and returning students, explain the society in twenty seconds, and invite them to the first community night.

title: Engineering kickoff and pizza night
description: Meet engineering-minded students, learn what the society is building, and propose the first projects and programs.

title: 3-2 pathways panel
description: Bring students, faculty, alumni, and program experience into one practical conversation about planning the 3-2 journey.

title: Project pitch night
description: Pitch problems worth solving, form interdisciplinary teams, define scope, and select projects that can be finished well.

title: Engineering showcase
description: Demonstrate what teams built, explain what failed, document what was learned, and invite the next group to continue the work.
